description: SC4J is the open-source RTS engine from Fog of War Labs. Try the included demo or install SC:R and SC:R CrossOver from the launcher.
heroDescription: SC4J is Fog of War Labs' open-source real-time strategy engine. It's written in Java and handles unit movement, combat, rendering, and replays. Games ship as mods you can install and launch in one place.
socialDescription: The launcher joins Beacon.Link, a decentralized peer-to-peer network where you can see which friends are online, chat, and find a room to play together.
downloadInstructions: Get the Windows ZIP from GitHub, extract it, and run SC4J.exe. The download includes Java.
selectCopy: Copy the selected address and paste it into the launcher.

scr.title: SC:R
scr.subtitle: StarCraft: Remastered
scr.description: SC:R recreates the gameplay of StarCraft: Remastered on SC4J. We're using maps and replays from players to reproduce and fix EUD compatibility issues, crashes, and desyncs.
scr.note: Requires an installed copy of StarCraft: Remastered (build 1.23.10).
scr.runInstruction: Select StarCraft: Remastered in the mod list. If the StarCraft: Remastered folder field is empty, click Browse and choose the game's installation folder containing .build.info. Then click Run.

enhanced.title: SC:R Enhanced
enhanced.subtitle: SC:R patch with extra features
enhanced.description: SC:R with convenience and extension features: EUD GRP support, EUD ANIM support for HD and HD2 graphics, fast map download over Beacon.Link, and more.
enhanced.note: Requires an installed copy of StarCraft: Remastered.
screenshots: A 1.16 EUD map drawing the GRPs it writes to memory
An EUD map replacing the Marine's HD graphics with an anim
enhanced.runInstruction: Select SC:R Enhanced in the mod list. It uses the same game folder setting as SC:R. If the StarCraft: Remastered folder field is empty, click Browse and choose the installation folder containing .build.info. Then click Run.

crossover.title: SC:R CrossOver
crossover.subtitle: Gameplay mod based on SC:R
crossover.description: CrossOver changes Marine stats and adds the Terran Unity-chan and the Zerg Myriarch. It's a standalone mod built from patched SC:R source code.
crossover.note: Requires an installed copy of StarCraft: Remastered.
crossover.runInstruction: Select SC:R Crossover in the mod list. It uses the same game folder setting as SC:R. If the StarCraft: Remastered folder field is empty, click Browse and choose the installation folder containing .build.info. Then click Run.

demo.title: Dawnhold and Cindermaw
demo.subtitle: SC4J RTS demo
demo.description: Dawnhold and Cindermaw face off in this playable demo of the SC4J engine.
demo.note: The demo comes with SC4J. In the launcher, open Mods, select SC4J Demo: Dawnhold and Cindermaw, and click Run.

more.title: More mods
more.description: Start with the template to add your own units or change the rules. Test your mod from the launcher, then publish a release on GitHub so others can install it using your repository URL.

installSteps: Copy the repository URL above. In the launcher's Mods tab, click Install mod and paste it into the GitHub repository field.
Click Next. Check the repository and release version, then click Install.
